name: Transaction Processing Status 4 Code
definition: Specifies the status of an instruction.

PACK.name: Acknowledged Accepted
PACK.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged/accepted for further processing by the account servicer.

PPRC.name: Pending Processing
PPRC.definition: Processing of the instruction is pending.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Instruction has been rejected for further processing.

REPR.name: In Repair
REPR.definition: Instruction is accepted but in repair.

CANP.name: Pending Cancellation
CANP.definition: Cancellation request from yourself for this instruction is pending waiting for further processing.

CPRC.name: Cancellation Requested
CPRC.definition: Cancellation request from the counterparty is awaiting for your cancellation request or your consent.

MPRC.name: Modification Requested
MPRC.definition: Modification request from the counterparty is awaiting for your modification request or your consent.
